scope: HMM and TFT model datasets; intended prediction-date floor, not proof of training readiness
coverage_required: Verify source and feature coverage for every selected training period; unavailable history remains an explicit gap.
availability_required: Each feature must have evidence that its information was available at the prediction cutoff. Current observations and entity snapshots cannot be backdated.
prior_evidence_policy: Retain earlier evidence where needed for valid lookbacks or relationship history; the model start does not delete raw or curated data.
enforcement_status: Policy recorded; model dataset preparation and enforcement are not yet implemented.
